subject: Unable to complete supplier portal activation - SSO created duplicate merchant record
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@novus-inc.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novus-inc.com
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier portal activation failed — merchant id mismatch

Hi Sean,

We tried to complete the supplier activation for our vendor 'Helix Components' (PO # 987654) but after clicking the activation link in the email the portal redirected to a new account page and created a second merchant record for the same EIN. Now the PO is stuck in approval with a "vendor duplicate" hold and AP can't release payment.

Screenshot attached (screenshot-portal-error.png).

What happened: we authenticate with our enterprise SSO (SAML) and the redirect looks normal, but the portal shows a newly-provisioned vendor id (looks like a tenant collision). Our IT team confirmed the NameID in the assertion is the corporate email alias (payables@novus-inc.com) instead of the specific user identity that completed the flow.

We need this unblocked today — this is a high-priority vendor with an outstanding invoice. Can you:
- confirm whether the activation flow is creating duplicate merchant records on SAML asserts with shared nameIDs
- either merge the two vendor profiles or manually move PO #987654 to the correct vendor record

Thanks — appreciate the quick help.

Cheers,
Alice Chen
Senior Procurement Manager
Novus, Inc.

Hi Alice — thanks for the heads up and the screenshot. Sorry you're seeing this.

Quick answers: we're on it. I've looped in Ben from SSO/integration and Monica from Vendor Ops so we can triage and either merge the merchant records or move the PO. To help us debug could you send the vendor name exactly as it appears in both records (if you can see both), or the two vendor IDs? Also, if your IT team can forward the SAML response snippet (NameID + email attribute) that will speed things up.

Ben/Monica — flagged as P1 for payment hold. Initial hypothesis is NameID aliasing on Novus' IdP causing the portal to treat the request as a new identity and create a second profile instead of linking to the existing vendor (we've seen this before when NameID is shared role account vs user). Can one of you pick this up and post ETA?

I'll keep Novus updated.

- Sean

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Supplier portal activation failed — merchant id mismatch (technical notes)

Forwarding Alice's note with some quick findings from the logs.

Findings:
- Incoming SAML assertion for Novus shows Subject/NameID = payables@novus-inc.com (role address).
- Vendor record 55812 (existing Helix Components) is tied to primary contact alice.chen@novus-inc.com.
- New vendor record 90477 was automatically provisioned when activation link completed because our provisioning rule uses NameID as unique key for idempotency. Since NameID didn't match alice.chen@novus-inc.com, system assumed a new user and created a new vendor profile.
- There is no duplicate EIN check at the provisioning step (by design to avoid false merges), so duplicates can be created if assertions use role addresses.

Recommended immediate mitigations:
1) Manual merge of vendor 90477 into 55812 and reassign PO #987654 to 55812 so AP can release payment (we can do this now).
2) Short-term config: update Novus tenant mapping to prefer email attribute 'user.email' over NameID for provisioning to avoid role-account collisions. We'll need IdP change, so this is Novus IT action.
3) Longer-term: add EIN cross-check during provisioning as an optional safeguard (engineering change request).

I've attached a redacted SAML response snippet (saml-response-snippet.txt) showing the NameID.

Monica — can you do the manual merge and confirm once PO is visible to AP? Also please coordinate with Sean for customer comms.

-ben
Ben Carter
SSO & Integrations Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Supplier portal activation failed — merchant id mismatch

Hi Alice — quick update from Vendor Ops:

We completed a manual merge of vendor record 90477 into 55812 and re-assigned PO #987654 to the existing Helix Components profile. AP should see the PO in the correct vendor's ledger now; please confirm on your side.

What we changed:
- Merged duplicate profile and moved all attachments and recent activity to 55812.
- Added a temporary internal flag on the Novus tenant to prefer the attribute user.email over NameID for provisioning while Ben coordinates the IdP mapping change with your IT team.

Ben noted the IdP is sending a role address as NameID; Novus IT will need to send the user's specific email in either NameID or a consistently-mapped attribute (we recommended user.email).

Next steps:
- Alice: confirm PO visibility and payment release.
- Ben/Sean: schedule follow-up with Novus IT to update the assertion mapping (Ben to provide exact attribute mapping).
- Internal: engineering ticket created (RED-9821) to add optional EIN cross-check during provisioning.

Sorry for the disruption — let us know if anything else pops up.

Thanks,
